title: Opening Add-bot / Share-game by deep link replaces whatever ProfileDialog is open
trigger: Edit Contact box open with typed changes, click a t.me/<bot>?startgroup= or ?game= link.
effect: open_add_bot_dialog/open_share_game_dialog overwrite the single profile_dialog slot (EditContact, Birthday, ...) without closing or asking; the typed edits are lost and returning shows nothing.
fix: Queue the new box behind the open one or refuse while a ProfileDialog with edits is open.

title: Restart after Unblock is sent even when the unblock failed or was deduped
trigger: Bot chat blocked, press Restart while offline or while an unblock is already in flight.
effect: unblock_peer ignores its own result and always calls start_bot_from_bar when restart is set, so /start is sent to a still-blocked bot and the unblock error note is replaced by 'Starting bot'.
fix: Run the restart only on the Ok(Some) arm, or chain it on the unblock answer.

title: 'Show more' join requests drops its error and a refused send
trigger: Click 'Show more' while another page is in flight (load_more returns Ok(None)) or the send fails (Err).
effect: Nothing happens and no note shows; the button looks dead.
fix: Report Err as a StatusNote and disable the button while join_request_latest is set (derive it from the Fetch stage).

title: Wallpaper file picker answer is applied to whichever chat look dialog is open, not the one that asked
trigger: Click From file in chat A's look dialog, leave the native picker open, close the dialog (Esc) and open chat B's look dialog, then pick a file
effect: The file becomes chat B's pending wallpaper and Apply uploads it to B
fix: Capture the dialog's target (LookTarget) when the picker starts and apply the path only if the open dialog still has that target.

title: ChatUi of a chat the reducer closed survives and is kept on reopen
trigger: Have a reply bar / rich editor / pending delete box in chat A, A is removed or left from elsewhere so session.open_chat becomes None, then open A again.
effect: sync_chat_ui returns when open_chat is None and nothing calls leave_chat_ui; enter_chat_ui then sees chat_ui.chat==Some(A) and keeps the stale value, so old bars and open flags come back.
fix: Have sync_chat_ui replace the value with ChatUi::for_chat(None) when open_chat is None.

title: Attach picker answer is applied while the passcode lock is on
trigger: Open the attach picker (portal, non-modal), lock Quill, choose files.
effect: spawn_screen continuation runs attach_picked_in under the lock: files are added to the tray and check_tray_videos starts ffprobe reads while locked.
fix: Wait for the unlock with wait_for_unlock like os_open, or drop the answer on locked_since(count).

title: confirm_delete starts the vanish effect before the delete is issued
trigger: Confirm Delete when delete_confirmed fails (client closing, flood).
effect: begin_vanish records dust for the rows first; the Err arm only notes, so the message plays its disintegration though it still exists.
fix: Start the vanish on the Ok arm only.

title: Sent-hashtag memory and scroll reset happen before the send is refused
trigger: Type '#tag hello' and press Send where slow mode, rights, size limit or the paid confirm refuses the send.
effect: forget_scroll_on_return_to_latest and remember_sent_hashtags already ran, so the hashtag is remembered and the reader's saved scroll is dropped for a message that was not sent.
fix: Run them in deliver_live_send after the snapshots are accepted.

title: clear_draft_on_success is set before the ack and never cleared on failure
trigger: Send a rich message or voice note that fails; the Option<DraftClear> (whole_composer matches any stored text) stays set. A later successful send in that chat pushes draft_clears.
effect: finish_successful_sends (spawn_call_notification.rs:376) then matches the stale flag and clears the chat's draft if the composer is idle, though the draft was not the sent one.
fix: Key the flag by request id / send token and drop it on the error arm and on chat or account change.

title: Composer link/date/code-language boxes are not closed or re-keyed on a chat change
trigger: Open Formatting > Date (or Add Link / Code Language) on a selection in chat A, then change the open chat by a notification click, link or agent while the box is open, and Save.
effect: The boxes live in ComposerUi (not ChatUi) holding a byte range plus selected text; the only guard is that the text at the range still equals the remembered string. If chat B's draft has the same text there, the date/link is applied to the wrong chat's draft.
fix: Move the three boxes into ChatUi so enter_chat_ui replaces them.

title: 'Send as a document' for an edit replacement is window state, the edit is chat state
trigger: Tick 'Send as a document' while editing media in chat A, switch to chat B that has its own edit in progress, pick a replacement file.
effect: edit_replace_as_file lives in ComposerUi (per window) and is reset only in begin_edit and clear_edit_replacement; chat B's edit inherits chat A's choice.
fix: Store as_file in EditMediaReplacement / MediaEdit in the ChatUi.

title: Link, date and Code Language dialogs belong to the composer, not to the chat shown
trigger: Select text in chat A, press Ctrl+K (link_dialog stores a byte range plus the selected string), then change chat by keyboard/link while the box is open and press Save in a chat whose composer holds the same text at that range.
effect: The link or language is applied to chat B's composer text. The only guard is text equality of the range, not the chat.
fix: Put the three composer boxes into ChatUi (replaced when the chat or topic changes) or store the SendSlot in each and refuse when it differs.

title: A key in a chat window's message menu closes the main window's chat-row submenu
trigger: In the main window right-click a chat row and hover a row with a submenu, so it opens. Without closing it, right-click a message in a chat window and press an arrow key.
effect: open_submenu() reads the screen-wide chat_list.menu / community row_menu. parent_of finds no parent in the chat window's items, so the main window's submenu is closed as stale.
fix: Read open_submenu only when !windows.in_window(), the same gate as main_menu_open.

title: scroll_view_probe is not reset when the history key changes, while scroll_top_probe is
trigger: Scroll chat A down so its rows 40..55 are on screen, open chat B (or switch topic); before B's first paint press PageUp/PageDown, click the open chat in the list, or let the render choose chrome rows
effect: The page keys, reselect_open_chat (first_unread_below_view), history_a11y and chrome_due_rows read A's row range for B's rows: wrong page jump or chrome refreshed for the wrong rows for a frame
fix: Reset every per-history probe together in one `HistoryUi::for_new_key()` (or keep the probes in a struct keyed by history_key).

title: Any pending outgoing message newer than the view counts as 'the reader just sent it' and scrolls the history to the end
trigger: Scroll up in a chat in the main window. Forward a message into that chat from a chat window, or have the agent send one into it.
effect: sent_since takes any is_outgoing && pending() message after the newest one as the reader's own send in this view. The main window jumps to the bottom and loses the reader's place, although the send came from another window or the agent.
fix: Mark sends made from this view (the composer's send records its local id in the window's ChatUi) and test that mark, not just pending outgoing state.

title: A dismissed one-time bot keyboard is remembered per window, not per chat
trigger: Open a bot chat with a one-time reply keyboard in a chat window, press a button (the keyboard hides there), and look at the same chat in another window while offline or before TDLib's updateChatReplyMarkup lands.
effect: MessageUi lives in the WindowSlot, so dismissed_keyboards and collapsed_keyboards keyed (chat, message) apply only in the window that pressed. The other window keeps showing the one-time keyboard until TDLib clears the markup, and an offline dismissal never reaches it.
fix: Keep the dismissed set per chat with its owner, keyed AccountChat, in the session's per-chat reply-markup state, which every window reads. Keep collapsed (a per-view choice) per window if that is intended.

title: Debounced emoji pack search still fires after the box is closed
trigger: Type in the emoji packs search, close the box within 300 ms
effect: close_emoji_sets does not bump emoji_set_keystroke, so the timer still matches: search_emoji_packs runs, switches the session tab to Search and sends searchEmojiSets for a closed box (wasted request, stale found_sets)
fix: Hold the debounce as a Task in the box state and drop it on close, or bump the keystroke in close_emoji_sets.

title: Emoji packs box: closing does not cancel the debounced search or clear the search field
trigger: Open Settings > Emoji sets, type 'cat', close the box within 300 ms (search goes out with the box closed and switches emoji.tab to Search); or type 'cat', wait, close and reopen.
effect: A search request runs for a closed box; on reopen the field still reads 'cat' while the list and tab show Installed until the field is edited.
fix: Hold the box as one value (open, tab, query, keystroke token) that close_emoji_sets drops; bump the token and clear the field on close/open.

title: Quick set switches can save a different choice than the one shown
trigger: Click set A then set B within a frame or two
effect: switch_task is replaced but A's background closure may already be running and calls save_current(A) after B's save, so the saved choice is A while the UI shows B until restart
fix: Save the choice on the UI thread in the apply step (only the latest task applies), not in the background closure.

title: Emoji set download notifies the whole app every 120 ms even while its box is closed
trigger: Start an emoji set download, close the Choose emoji set box (the download keeps going by design).
effect: Wasted work: QuillApp is notified and redrawn about 8 times a second for the whole download, with no progress drawn anywhere.
fix: Notify only while the box is open (or give the progress its own entity that the box observes).

title: A Failed inline query for the current (chat, bot, query) is never re-asked
trigger: A first-page inline query fails (network).
effect: maybe_dispatch_inline_query returns early because the slot matches (fresh), so retyping the same query does nothing; the user must change the query text.
fix: Treat Failed as not fresh, or offer retry from the status line.

title: Closing the results panel (Esc) does not cancel an armed 100 ms query
trigger: Type '@bot q' then press Esc within 100 ms.
effect: close_inline_results clears inline_query_armed but the timer's token still matches, so the query is sent anyway (panel stays closed, wasted request).
fix: Bump the token on close.

title: autoplayed_gifs is marked before the GIF starts
trigger: A GIF autoplays but its file is outside the sandbox or waits for download (play_when_ready).
effect: The row is marked autoplayed even though nothing played, so it is never autoplayed again this visit; tapping still works.
fix: Mark in gif_started.

title: A sleeping slot whose reopen fails is retried on every history pass
trigger: A sleeping clip is painted in view but VideoPlayer::open fails (file deleted/moved).
effect: revive returns without a stage change, so each sweep opens the file again every frame the tile is visible.
fix: On open failure move the slot to a Failed stage so it shows the still.

title: A display-scale change drops every player but keeps on_demand and the sound mode of the dropped ones
trigger: Move the main window to a screen with another scale while a round video plays with sound.
effect: Players are dropped and restart muted looping; on_demand entries for them are only cleared via forget; a chat window on its own screen uses the main window's scale.
fix: Per-window scale in State.

title: flush_inline_return scans the bot chat history every frame while a return waits
trigger: A return is waiting after the start was sent and the bot never answers with a switch-inline button.
effect: Each frame walks all loaded messages; never ends (no way out).
fix: Give the Started stage an expiry and stop scanning.

title: One shared message_menu_actions slot is cleared by any window's menu, viewer or profile photo ask
trigger: With a message menu open in a chat window, step the main window's viewer or open a profile photo (each calls fetch_message_menu_actions, which sets the slot to None).
effect: The open menu's rows fall back to the local guesses (delete for all, edit, pin rows can appear or vanish) until the other answer lands and overwrites the slot with another message's actions that the menu then ignores.
fix: Key the answers by (chat, message) in a small map, or per window view, instead of one slot that every asker resets.

title: Most menu items close the menu without close_message_menu, so reaction options and the paid-reaction offer are not reset
trigger: Open the message menu on a message (reaction options are asked), pick Reply or any row, then open another menu quickly.
effect: close_message_menu is the only place that calls reset_message_reactions (Idle, paid.offered=None); the ~40 direct `menu = None` sites skip it, leaving the old message's options/offer in the session until the next fetch overwrites them.
fix: Make closing the menu one function (or the Drop of the menu stage) that also resets the session's reaction state.

title: Effect badge registries are process-global thread-locals keyed by bare (chat, message) ids
trigger: Click a message effect badge, switch account in the same frame; or leave a badge unseen/seen entry while switching to an account that has a chat with the same id.
effect: BADGES, REPLAYS and the overlay's WAITING survive an account switch and carry no account, so a queued replay or seen-badge note can apply to the other account's message with the same ids (private chat ids and small message ids collide).
fix: Key them by AccountChat/ChatMessage owner keys and clear them in the OnScreen replacement (or own them in OnScreen).

title: WAITING is a process-wide thread-local keyed by bare (chat, message) with no account or window
trigger: Ask for a message effect in a private chat with contact X on account A (WAITING gets an entry for up to 30 s), switch to account B within that time and open the chat with the same contact (private chat ids equal user ids), where a message has the same numeric id and a drawn badge.
effect: retain() keeps the entry because the chat id is in B's shown set and badge::seen(key) is true, so A's effect id plays over B's message (or its lookup is asked on B's session).
fix: Hold the waiting list in OnScreen (per account, per window slot) and key it by ChatMessage; it then goes with the screen.

title: A lost getMessageEffect answer is never asked again
trigger: The request for an effect description is dropped (connection reset, logout race) without an error answer.
effect: effects.requested keeps the id, wanted() filters it out for ever, the Waiting entry times out after 30 s, and the effect never plays for the rest of the session.
fix: Make each effect id a Fetch<MessageEffect> (idle/loading/ready/failed) with the loading arm left by the answer, the error and the owner going away.

title: Copy Option Link and Delete Item ignore a send error
trigger: Poll option menu, Copy Option Link or Delete Item while the request cannot be sent (not connected, chats path inactive).
effect: The menu closes and nothing happens; no status note (the comment relies on message_action_note, which only hears TDLib answers).
fix: Turn the Err arm into StatusNote::error like the other menu rows.

title: Save to Saved Messages says it needs a live account when only the user id or draft is missing
trigger: Message menu, Save to, Saved Messages while connected but my_user_id is not yet known (or the draft cannot be built).
effect: The else arm shows the demo note 'Saved Messages needs a live account' instead of an error, and the menu closes.
fix: Match live, me and draft separately and give each missing piece its own outcome.

title: wanted_reactor_tab intent can outlive its menu
trigger: Right-click a reaction chip on a message whose properties request fails or returns can_get_added_reactions false; later open the normal menu on the same message.
effect: The intent is only taken inside fetch_message_audience; if that never runs for this menu it stays and a later open of that message fetches a reactor tab nobody asked for.
fix: Carry the wanted tab in the menu's own state (message_ui.menu_ui) so it dies when the menu closes.

title: A failed reactor tab or viewer list shows 'no views' instead of an error
trigger: Open Seen/Reacted page when getMessageAddedReactions fails (Audience::Failed).
effect: The page has no rows and nothing loading, so it shows the empty text; there is no error and no retry (a tab already Failed is only re-asked by reselecting it).
fix: Draw an Audience::Failed arm with a Retry row.
